title: Jalendrel of House Beaumayn
summary: A visionary knight of House Beaumayn.

claims.text: Jalendrel became one of the great knights of the age, famed for courage and for compassion toward commoners, mortal and fae; at Jalendrel's passing into the Dreaming, stars fell and blue flowers grew where they struck.
Wise folk say that when those blue flowers bloom again, Jalendrel will return to lead the house against the evils foretold in old prophecy.
Like House Liam, with whom it often shared lands, Beaumayn grew fond of mortals before the Sundering.

title: The Volva and mothers of House Aesin

claims.text: The Volva of House Aesin are honored seers skilled in cantrips and soothsaying, who carry a wooden staff given at their inauguration.
Mothers raise the house's childlings and introduce newborn Aesin to its ways.
Ragnelf took the throne of House Aesin after Ingirun died and rebuilt a strong house from a family broken by war; Ragnelf is known for kindness and for treating the mind as the sharpest weapon.
House Aesin has had few dealings with mortal wizards, regarding them as an intriguing threat.
